name: [v1.8.1] The Overview Update!
body:
### This smaller update puts emphasis on mostly quality of life improvements to the Template Editor allowing to filter through all templates globally, single-select dropdowns, the Visual Layout Editor, settings and templates.

## New features

- The Template Editor `Show All` lists every template in the editor, grouped by Minecraft version and has a matching new setting, that is remembered between sessions (through the settings.json file).
- **Double-clicking** a template in the editor opens the editor view.
- **Ctrl/Cmd + A** in the Visual Layout Editor selects all items, including ones off-screen.
- Choosing settings when creating a preset: you pick which settings go into a new preset, the rest stay at their defaults.
- `1.16.1 AA Categorical` settings preset by ScrambledMC is now available. It's the foundation for all `Categorical` templates, with additional changes listed at the bottom of each template on the tracker map.
- Every single-choice dropdown can now be **cycled through** with the scroll wheel.
- Run Completion:
  - Introduced a separate Progress Percentage goal type, so it can be picked apart from Advancements.
  - The label can always be changed.
  - Added a second `Progress Label` field that shows up if the progress is being displayed.
- Templates and assets:
  - Added a new 26.4 (basic) all_advancements template, that just displays all of the 26.4 advancements through the automatic layout, none are hidden.
  - Fully added all 26.3 item and block textures.
  - ScrambledMC made a new `jp` (japanese) translation for his 1.16.1 categorical template.
  - Updated all of Scrambled's templates, plus `all_blocks`, where the `Trident` goal was slightly renamed.
  - The 1.20+ AATool templates now focus on the collected trims on the overlay and show also the smithed ones on the tracker map. This is similar to what AATool does.
  - Added the new 26.4 ice ball advancement.
  - **Caves & Cliffs** is shortened to **Cliffs** in the AATool optimized templates (same for German).
- On Windows: Advancely.exe now shows company, product name, version and copyright in its file properties.

## Changes & improvements

- `Hide Completed Row 3 Goals` is now `Show Completed Row 3 Goals` and **On** by default.
- The Template Editor's search now picks the scope (where it searches) through where you last interacted with.
- Tracker Manual Layout:
  - The scrollbar now hides when positionally hidden sub-items mean it isn't needed anymore. Lists that never needed to scroll keep their gaps.
  - A hidden sub-icon gives its spot to the text and progress, unless those are positioned separately.
- The Visual Layout Editor only fades items that are manually hidden, not ones hidden by the automatic layout/overlay.
- Movement keys that were part of a modifier combo stay inactive until pressed again (Mainly affecting Ctrl/Cmd + A by default as A would also be moving left).
- Checked entries in the preset popups now persist when toggling the `Only Changes` filter.
- The settings window has a new height and opens vertically centered when it shows up for the first time.
- The `Restart Overlay` tooltip now makes it clear that it doesn't re-read settings changes, the `Apply Settings` button still has to be clicked for that.
- The macOS app translocation warning now mentions the `xattr` command.

## Fixes

- ENTER creates a new line in the description fields again instead of just saving.
- Stat, sub-stat and custom goal checkboxes are now hidden together with their icons.
- A language or layout selected before editing a template now carries over into the editor.
- Hermes now correctly defaults to on when settings are reset to defaults and when creating a settings preset.
- The AATool templates's coop stats merge is set back to cumulative; had been changed by accident.
- macOS:
  - If resources/templates is missing, the `.seed_version` markes is no longer written, so moving the resources folder back next to the .app correctly fills `Application Support`.
  - The CI test run no longer hangs.

-----

> Find more info on the [tracker main page](https://github.com/LNXSeus/Advancely)!
